description: This file contains the definition of the EndpointArnMiddleware class in the Aws\S3Control namespace. The class implements middleware logic to process AWS S3 Control ARNs for access points and buckets, modifying requests accordingly, especially for Outposts ARNs.

classes.name: EndpointArnMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that inspects and modifies requests based on ARN information for AWS S3 access points and buckets, specifically handling Outposts, ARNs, and endpoint adjustments.
